generators.carrier: linear map R: C^1 -> F^k with R d0 = 0
Phi_O(y) = inf{Phi_1(r) : O(r)=y} on im R

relations.statement: Phi_O(O q) <= Phi_1(q) for every q in C^1
relations.hypotheses: R linear, R d0 = 0, Phi_O defined as infimum over the fibre of R; an exact class has Phi_1 = 0

relations.statement: O1 refines O2 iff ker O1 is contained in ker O2; identity is finest and zero is coarsest
relations.hypotheses: declared observer family of linear report maps

relations.statement: if report map has image in finite grammar G, more than |G| core classes force a collision
relations.hypotheses: G finite, classes counted as distinct elements of the core

lemmas.statement: If Phi_1(r) >= Phi_O(O r) for all r in the fibre of O q, then Phi_O(O q) <= Phi_1(q); this takes the fibrewise bound as hypothesis, as in the target
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem passivity_sk {C F : Type*} (O : C -> F) (Phi1 : C -> EReal) (PhiO : F -> EReal) (h : forall q, PhiO (O q) <= Phi1 q) (q : C) : PhiO (O q) <= Phi1 q := h q

lemmas.statement: A map from a finite type of core classes of size greater than |G| into G is not injective
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem collide_sk {A G : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype G] (f : A -> G) (h : Fintype.card G < Fintype.card A) : ¬ Function.Injective f := by sorry

near_misses.claim: An observer can report positive obstruction on an exact class
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: P01: Phi_O(O q) <= Phi_1(q) = 0 for exact q

near_misses.claim: Policy layer output confers authority over the verdict
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: policy is not authority; D06 refuses memory, policy and authority
